title: Stuffed champignons
instructions: Cut up bacon into small squares and fry it up until browned and crispy.
Remove the legs from mushrooms and clean both parts.
Dice the mushrooms stems and add them into the bacon to cook them a little.
Once done, let cool off slightly and add fresh cheese, a bit of salt, pepper, and rosemary.
Fill the mushroom heads with this stuffing and lay on lightly oiled up parchment paper.
Bake at 190C for about 15-20 minutes, based on mushroom's size. Top should took golden and sides browned.
Serve with lightly toasted bread or salad.
Optionally add diced ham/cheese/spring onion on top of champignons.
